title: Federal Court Cases: Integrated Data Base, 2005
description:
The purpose of this data collection is to provide an
official public record of the business of the federal courts. The data
originate from district and appellate court offices throughout the
United States. Information was obtained at two points in the life of a
case: filing and termination. The termination data contain information
on both filing and terminations, while the pending data contain only
filing information.

contactPoint.fn: Ask BJS Bureau of Justice Statistics (USDOJ)

rights: These data are restricted due to the increased risk of violation of confidentiality of respondent and subject data.
